reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering Void foods and fish, mining nodes, fish, a quest keepsake, teleportation totems, a combat ring, and flooring were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established glossary, place and fish names, Void terminology, teleport destinations and consumption, combat effects, source punctuation, object gender, and quest context; both found no remaining objective issue.

VoidMayonnaise_Description.source: A thick, black paste that smells like burnt hair.
VoidMayonnaise_Description.translation: O pastă neagră și groasă, care miroase a păr ars.

VoidSalmon_Description.source: A salmon, twisted by void energy. The fresh meat is jet black, but rapidly turns pink when exposed to air.
VoidSalmon_Description.translation: Un somon deformat de energia Vidului. Carnea proaspătă este neagră ca tăciunele, dar devine rapid roz când este expusă la aer.

VolcanoGoldNode_Description.source: Break apart to obtain gold ore.
VolcanoGoldNode_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține minereu de aur.

Walleye_Description.source: A freshwater fish caught at night.
Walleye_Description.translation: Un pește de apă dulce prins noaptea.

WarMemento_Description.source: It's a faded photograph of a soldier...
WarMemento_Description.translation: O fotografie decolorată a unui soldat...

WarpTotemBeach_Description.source: Warp directly to the beach. Consumed on use.
WarpTotemBeach_Description.translation: Teleportează-te direct la plajă. Se consumă la utilizare.

WarpTotemDesert_Description.source: Warp directly to Calico Desert. Consumed on use.
WarpTotemDesert_Description.translation: Teleportează-te direct în Deșertul Calico. Se consumă la utilizare.

WarpTotemFarm_Description.source: Warp directly to your house. Consumed on use.
WarpTotemFarm_Description.translation: Teleportează-te direct la casa ta. Se consumă la utilizare.

WarpTotemIsland_Description.source: Warp directly to Ginger Island. Consumed on use.
WarpTotemIsland_Description.translation: Teleportează-te direct pe Insula Ghimbirului. Se consumă la utilizare.

WarpTotemMountains_Description.source: Warp directly to the mountains. Consumed on use.
WarpTotemMountains_Description.translation: Teleportează-te direct în munți. Se consumă la utilizare.

WarpTotemQisArena_Name.translation: Totem de teleportare: Arena lui Qi

WarpTotemQisArena_Description.source: Warp to Qi's Arena. Be prepared for a challenge!.
WarpTotemQisArena_Description.translation: Teleportează-te în Arena lui Qi. Pregătește-te pentru o provocare!

WarriorRing_Description.source: Occasionally infuses the wearer with "warrior energy" after slaying a monster.
WarriorRing_Description.translation: Îl infuzează uneori pe purtător cu „energia războinicului” după uciderea unui monstru.
